summary: Practise IFRS S1/S2 materiality, controls, evidence and climate reporting. Explore the course and build a practical implementation plan.
lede: IFRS S1 and S2 implementation training helps finance, sustainability, risk and audit teams control sustainability-related financial disclosures. It covers materiality assessment, governance and control responsibilities, data ownership and evidence, and climate-risk analysis linked to operational and financial effects. Participants practise defining reporting scope, documenting data owners and evidence, and reviewing disclosures for gaps and consistency with financial reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, govern, test or use IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 sustainability-related financial disclosures.
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 Reporting Foundations
IFRS S2 Metrics and GHG Data
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with financial reporting, sustainability reporting, risk management or internal controls is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced climate scenario analysis and automated data workflows are introduced at an operational and conceptual level; the course focuses on scoping, documenting and reviewing their use rather than engineering production systems.
